note: Maps onboarding channel ids (lib/onboarding/data/channels.json) to Xandr publisher ids. Publisher ids are per member, so they are keyed by member id: 13720 is Alma's test member, 6931 is live. A null means that channel cannot be targeted on that member and the booking says so rather than silently serving everywhere. Placement ids are deliberately not used — targeting the publisher holds the line item to that title's inventory without enumerating every ad slot.
